name: app-client-tauri
description: Tauri shell for the desktop client. Run from this directory: `npm run dev`, `npm run package:linux`. The scripts are deliberately NOT named build or typecheck: the suite's shared test.yml runs every package.json that declares either, and this one needs a Rust toolchain the runner does not have. The Rust side is checked with `cargo check` in this directory instead.

scripts.package:linux: tauri build --bundles appimage && mkdir -p ../../dist/tauri && cp target/release/bundle/appimage/*.AppImage ../../dist/tauri/
